Nice Seafood buffet
Apr 2021 • Couples
Meal:
- Lobster was definitely the highlight; all you can eat, just order through your waiter.
- Oysters fresh and large or baked in cheese . 
- Crabs are excellent. 
- Sashimi and sushi are excellent, very fresh. 
- BBQ prawns, pork, beef and others are nice. 
- Lots of desserts available and the ice creams are very good.
- Thai foods are very delicious.
- Dont try cheese, not good.

 The service is good. They talk well, behave politely and very helpful.

Really pleased with everything that we tried including the desserts. The free one beer was nice.

Hummus & Bread were Highly Disappointing
Feb 2018 • Solo
As I was staying at this Hotel, I decided to try out the restaurant for a light dinner. 
I was disappointed when I received my order of Gulf Hummus Be Thahini with Green salad. 

The hummus was the worst hummus I had ever eaten and I have eaten authentic middle eastern cuisine. It was rather very dry and lacked the lemon sour touch in it. The Brbad was as hard as a rock and lacked the soft spongy feel which is usually served with hummus. The salad was the only highlight of the dish. 

The staff were very good, if only had the food had been a little better. Considering the location of the restaurant in a 5* hotel, the food is a little bit on the expensive side.

reviews.review_text:
Kevin H
1 contribution

Horrible service and attitude
Dec 2016 • Family
I ate at this buffet restaurant of the Windsor Hotel with my family. We've been visiting this place since it was opened. However, the services and food are getting worse and worse every time we visit. 
They do offer more and more variety of food. However, the problem is since there are too many types of food, along with not so professional staffs, the service will surely goes down. I asked for sashimi and I had to wait for more than 10 minutes just for a girl to call another girl, who appeared to be a chef, to cut the salmon for me. However the sashimi had a very disturbing taste, and the problem is, when I reported this issue to other employees working that night, they just ignored me. And when they finally come and clean up the table for my family, they told my Vietnamese sister that if we couldn't finish our food, we had to pay more! I was so angry because I had told them the issues regarding the taste and the freshness of the salmon I had. However, they all assumed that because we couldn't eat sashimi so we blamed their food. That was the most ridiculous reasons I've ever heard!
We were having dinner that night, and I believe that some type of soccer championship is going on that night and Vietnam was one of the teams that was competing that night. And not only the customers were absolutely disturbingly noisy, but also the staffs and employees. They ignored our orders and needs just to watch the game. Additionally, they were cheering and yelling in a very disturbing way whenever it seemed that the Vietnamese team was about to score a goal. 
There was one horrible lady who even yelled at me and my sister when we asked her to assist us making the cotton candy, my sister could speak Vietnamese, and she told me the lady who yelled at us said "Don't call me, I am not free at the moment, can't you see? Please do it yourself, you are not retarded, aren't you?". I was absolutely furious about that. Never had I been to any restaurant that has this kind of employees, yelling at their customers. We also tried to ask other employees to help us to calm the other customers too, but what I received was ignorance. It seemed like they couldn't even understand English, and later my sister told me that she over heard one of the employees whispering to others "Please just go home if you think this place is noisy!" and all other employees were also saying "Yeah just go back to China you pig!". I mean, just because my family is Chinese doesn't mean that we were from China right? I was so furious about that type of attitude towards customers! 
All I wanted was just a pleasant dinner to relax with my family. But no, they didn't give us a pleasant night at all. My perfect night was ruined!
Definitely not coming back ever again!

Good buffet
Oct 2016 • Family
It's good in general. Fresh seafood (crayfish and oyster), salmon sashimi. Many choices are available, from Vietnamese traditional springroll, salad, cheese, Japanese teppanyaki, bbq to Italian food. Cotton candy is an attractive to children. 

However, the Restaurant is too large, the stations are far away from each other. If you want your oyster to be grill, tou have to bring to the station outside at the end of the Restaurant, leave it there and comeback after 20 minutes to pickup. 

They also charge 50% for children from 4 to 12 years old. I don't think it is an approriate charge. The family sitting next to my table has 2 children. They are 4 and 6 years old and they hardy ate anything during the meal but their parents had to pay 668++ for them. A child at 4 or 6 doesn't eat that much!

Buffet to cater to all tastes
Jun 2016 • Couples
Within our hotel and tempted by the Indian night advertised. Few starters and dishes available but not lots but chef asked if he could help as did restaurant manager. We were shown round the huge number of buffet offerings, everything you could think of.

Indian dishes called us first and we're looking for the yoghurt did and chef went to make us some which was great, reminder of home. The dishes were few but we'll made and we were quizzed on our thoughts. 

Dare I say too much choice as I ambled between the food stations picking up fresh sushi, King prawn dishes and wonderful desserts. Hubby has roast beef and mash which he thoroughly enjoyed along get with the ice cream station

Would recommend for all tastes
